messages.text: I bought the overclocking kit, Do I really need it, if the system already comes with a power supply
Searched the catalog · overclocking kit power kit accessory

No, you don't need it. The B.4 already ships with its own Mean Well LRS-350 power supply and cord, so the kit's PSU is really a spare. What the kit adds is the cooling side: nine heatsinks, thermal paste and wipes, for people who want to push the clocks.

Worth knowing: running a unit overclocked isn't covered by warranty, so most people run stock and keep the kit's heatsinks as a cooling upgrade.

Want me to pull up your order and see what's on it?
